agyos_skill.intent: Physics Tuner. Finds the numbers that decide how the game moves (speed, gravity, grip, jump height, frame rate) and tunes them. Scans the user's own game ELF for a float32 value stored in data or built in code (lui, ori or addiu, then mtc1), shows the instructions that read it, lists frame-timing candidates, and prints the exact pnach lines to test a new value in PCSX2 plus the PS2Recomp fix (TOML instruction patches or the data write /console-mod bakes in). Reads only; writes nothing. Use when the user says \
